name: Noin
source:
Estimated Age: Unknown (Self-proclaimed 16 years old)

A weapons merchant who set up shop in a corner of "Cafe Tsukikage".
He has a candid personality and is honest with his feelings.
He looks like a young boy, but is actually an adult. 
Because he always answers that he is '16 years old' when people ask, his real age is unknown.
